coverage.message: The match is live-listed, but numeric live state is not present yet. Keep polling the coverage endpoint before treating live-state webhooks as expected.

definitions.live_row: The match is currently present in Cito live discovery or live cache.
definitions.numeric_live_state: Current kills, gold, towers, objectives, player stats, or game clock are present.
definitions.postgame_enrichment: Section-by-section postgame coverage for completed games. Use availableSections and missingSections on /lol/games/{gameId}/postgame for the exact game-level contract.
definitions.recommended_rule: For production decisions, require schedule_metadata + live_row + numeric_live_state. For LCK CL / Academy, never assume live state before this pre-check confirms it.
definitions.schedule_metadata: A stored schedule/match row exists in Cito.
definitions.webhook_event: Cito has enough numeric live-state data to emit lol.live.state webhooks for subscribed users.
